The '''Treffani system''' was a part of the [[Treffani sector/Legends|Treffani sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the beverage known as [[Treffanian ale]].<ref name="Triton">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/triton20080820.html|text="Deader than a Triton Moon"|int=Deader than a Triton Moon|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Treffanian ale]]|system=Treffani [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Treffani [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-14.<ref name="TEA" />
